title: Invertibility of the completed composition map on one tower
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, a field k with ell invertible, and composable separated finite-type k-morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y→Z between finite-type k-schemes. For a compactification d of g, a compactification e of f followed by d.i, and an integral constructible input K on X [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed; def-weil-compactifications-refinements], the open unit h_eta in the definition of sfCompletedCompositionOnTower is invertible; the specified restriction comparison Lambda is invertible; and, with those proofs, the actual morphism sfCompletedCompositionOnTower(l,E,d,e,K) of [def-zl-field-shriek-composition-normalization] is invertible. This assertion is on one tower only, before refinement comparisons and transport to the recorded integral functors.

source.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7J, lemma-shriek-proper-and-open and lemma-shriek-composition; completed-coefficient passage: Bhatt--Scholze Definition 6.7.6, Lemma 6.7.7 and Lemma 6.1.13.

proof.text: The exact open extension is fully faithful, so its adjunction unit is invertible. Lambda is the restriction exchange on e.isPullback_restrict followed by inverse open unit. Its normalized strict reductions are the finite proper base-change isomorphisms on the constructible origins.

On the same strict reduction systems, the inverse open adjunct Gamma evaluates to the finite proper/open isomorphism. Completed proper image and quasi-compact open extension preserve the complete domain, so the cones of Lambda and Gamma are complete with zero reductions, hence zero.

Whisker Gamma by the outer proper functor and insert proper and open composition, followed by equality transport e.restrict_i_fst. Every factor is invertible, which proves invertibility of the displayed tower map. The same argument covers zero inputs and empty schemes.

theorem sfCompletedCompositionOnTower_isIso
    (d : Compactification g) (e : Compactification (f ≫ d.i))
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    ∃ hη : IsIso ((openDerivedAdjunction (completed l E) (pullback.fst e.g d.i)).unit.app
        ((openExtension (completed l E) e.restrict.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj)),
    ∃ hLambda : IsIso (sfCompositionLambda l E (pullback.fst e.g d.i) e.restrict.g e.g d.i
        e.isPullback_restrict.w.symm
          ((openExtension (completed l E) e.restrict.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj) hη),
      IsIso (sfCompletedCompositionOnTower l E d e K.obj hη hLambda)
